# asyntai_knowledge_url (Resource)

One web page in the knowledge base of a website. Asyntai reads the page when the item is created. To read the page again, replace the item (`terraform apply -replace=...`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asyntai_knowledge_url" "pricing" {
  website_id = asyntai_website.shop.id
  url        = "https://shop.example.com/pricing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Address of the page to add. Asyntai reads the page once, when the item is created. Changing it creates a new item.

### Optional

- `access_tags` (List of String) Access Tags (Enterprise plan): only visitors with one of these tags get answers from this item. Leave out for everyone.
- `website_id` (String) Id of the website the item belongs to. Defaults to the primary website of the account.

### Read-Only

- `chunks_count` (Number) Number of search chunks Asyntai made from the item.
- `created_at` (String) When the item was added.
- `id` (String) Knowledge base item id.
- `title` (String) Page title Asyntai read from the page.
